He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest Demon Deacons]]. ==Early life and high school career== Klintman was born in [[Malmö]], Sweden, to a Swedish mother and a father from [[Senegal]].{{cite web |title=Bobi Klintman Q&A |url=https://www.prospectiveinsight.com/post/bobi-klintman |website=Prospective Insight |access-date=26 July 2023 |language=English |date=11 Jun 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/snakes-strike-to-sign-next-star|title=Snakes Strike to Sign Next Star|website=NBL.com.au|date=13 June 2023|access-date=13 June 2023}} He attended Sweden's RIG Mark Academy in [[Kinna]].{{cite web|url=https://kansas.rivals.com/news/maryland-basketball-lands-commitment-from-swedish-three-star-wing|title=Maryland basketball lands commitment from Swedish three-star wing|first=Scott|last=Greene|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=13 October 2021|access-date=26 May 2023}} In the 2019–20 season, he played 13 games for RIG Mark in the third-tier [[Basketettan]].{{cite web|url=https://basketball.usbasket.com/player/Bo-Klintman/502029|title=Bo Klintman|work=usbasket.com|access-date=13 June 2023|url-access=subscription}} He continued with RIG Mark in the second-tier [[Superettan (basketball)|Superettan]] in 2020–21 before the season was cancelled in February 2021 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://netscoutsbasketball.com/blog/meeting-top-international-prospects-bobi-klintman/|title=Meeting Top International Prospects: Bobi Klintman|first=Carl|last=Berman|website=netscoutsbasketball.com|date=9 March 2021|access-date=13 June 2023}} He played six games for [[Borås Basket]] in the first-tier [[Swedish Basketball League|Basketligan]] to finish the season. Klintman enrolled at Sunrise Christian Academy in [[Bel Aire, Kansas]], for the 2021–22 U.S. high school year.{{Cite web |date=6 September 2021 |title=Recruit Bobi Klintman has KU basketball on list of 6 schools |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article254030063.html |access-date=19 April 2023 |website=[[The Kansas City Star]]}} He was rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and initially committed to playing college basketball for [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]].{{cite web|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2021/10/13/bobi-klintman-maryland-basketball-recruit/|title=Maryland men's basketball lands four-star Bobi Klintman as first recruit in 2022 class|work=[[The Washington Post]]|date=13 October 2021|access-date=26 May 2023}} He later decommitted from Maryland and committed to play for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]].{{cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/college/colorado-buffaloes/news/4-star-sf-bobi-klintman-commits-to-colorado/|title=4-star SF Bobi Klintman commits to Colorado|first=Joe|last=Tipton|website=On3.com|date=14 April 2022|access-date=26 May 2023}} Klintman decommitted a second time and ultimately signed to play for [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/4-star-forward-Bobi-Klintman-commits-to-Wake-Forest-former-Colorado-and-Maryland-commit-2022-basketball-recruiting-187523812/|title=Top150 prospect Bobi Klintman commits to Wake Forest|first=Travis|last=Branham|website=[[247Sports]]|date=13 May 2022|access-date=10 April 2023}} ==College career== As a freshman in the [[2022–23 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|2022–23 season]], Klintman played in 33 games with five starts and averaged 5.3 points and 4.5 rebounds in 20.5 minutes per game for the [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest Demon Deacons]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/bobi-klintman-1.html|title=Bobi Klintman|website=sports-reference.com|access-date=13 June 2023}} Klintman initially declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]]{{cite web|url=https://wakeforest.rivals.com/news/bobi-klintman-to-enter-nba-draft-while-maintaining-eligibility|title=Bobi Klintman to enter NBA draft while maintaining eligibility|first=Conor|last=O'Neill|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=6 April 2023|access-date=19 April 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/4382121/2023/04/06/bobi-klintman-nba-draft/|title=Why Bobi Klintman could be NBA Draft's mystery man — and why his declaration is so interesting|first=Sam|last=Vecenie|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=6 April 2023|access-date=10 April 2023}} and later informed Wake Forest that he would not return to the team for the 2023–24 season.{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2023/05/15/wake-forest-bobi-klintman-nba-draft-combine-promise/|title=Report: Wake Forest's Bobi Klintman has withdrawn from the draft combine|first=Cody|last=Taylor|website=Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=15 May 2023|access-date=26 May 2023}} ==Professional career== On 13 June 2023, Klintman signed with the [[Cairns Taipans]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL), joining the team as part of the league's ''Next Stars'' program for the [[2023–24 NBL season|2023–24 season]].{{cite web|url=https://www.taipans.com/news/taipans-secure-swedish-sensation|title=TAIPANS SECURE SWEDISH SENSATION|website=Taipans.com|date=13 June 2023|access-date=13 June 2023}} ==National team career== Klintman played for the Sweden men’s national under-18 basketball team in Finland in the Nordic championships where they won the gold medal. Klintman played for the [[Sweden men's national under-20 basketball team|Sweden under-20 basketball team]] in the [[2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]].{{cite web|url=https://www.bloggersodear.com/2022/7/24/23276336/bobi-klintman-dominates-at-fiba-u20-championship-wake-forest-wfu-deacs-demon-deacons|title=Bobi Klintman Dominates at FIBA U20 Championship|first=Adam|last=Bridgers|website=BloggerSoDear.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=24 July 2022|access-date=13 May 2023}} He was selected for the All-Star team. ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBL=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 NBL season|2023–24]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 Cairns Taipans season|Cairns]] | 23 || 6 || 21.3 || .443 || .357 || .793 || 4.8 || .7 || .8 || .5 || 9.7 {{S-end}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022–23 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]] | 33 || 5 || 20.5 || .407 || .368 || .743 || 4.5 || .8 || .5 || .6 || 5.3 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://godeacs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/bobi-klintman/6937 Wake Forest Demon Deacons bio] {{Cairns Taipans current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Klintman, Bobi}} [[Category:2003 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Borås Basket players]] [[Category:Cairns Taipans players]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Malmö]] [[Category:Swedish men's basketball players]] [[Category:Swedish people of Senegalese descent]] [[Category:Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball players]]
